corrections: Birth year 1971 and American citizenship are explicit in Al-Thawra June 3, 2025 profile. AUB and Carnegie corroborate Damascus origin. No birth day is inferred from MacArthur award age.
MacArthur and AUB give the master’s year as 1999; other biographical sources including Al-Thawra give 1998. Omit precise master’s year. Bachelor 1995 and doctorate 2003 agree.
AUB dates Emerald co-founding to 2016, whereas Carnegie narrative places co-founding before the 2015 White House event. Retain co-founder status without a precise founding year.
Current Thuan and Nicole Pham chair supersedes older Andrew and Erna Viterbi title. July 16, 2021 is announcement date, not inferred contract start.
ACM Prize is the 2017 award announced April 4, 2018; MIT retrospective explicitly confirms class. ACM original PDF direct open returned 403; no claimed full-PDF inspection.
2026 IEEE award appeared in 2025 MIT reports with differing publication dates; not used as evidence of 2026 physical attendance or an exact ceremony date.
NAM announcement is October 20, 2025, earlier than October 22 MIT coverage and March 2026 roundup.
November 16, 2026 report concerns summer honors and does not date the initial Forbes selection.
Radio reflections are not X-rays. Study demonstration, health monitoring, clinical trials and FDA authorization are distinct; no clinical-approval or treatment-efficacy claim made.

2022 Nature Medicine work credits first author Yuzhe Yang, senior author Katabi and clinical collaborators; not her solo work. Nature article direct open failed at publisher identity redirect; claims rely on read MIT research report, with no claimed review of journal full text.
sourceReview.limits: Predominantly institutional reporting; no independent replication of measurements or review of regulatory records. Secondary birth-year source. No human/native-language certification.
